text:
Emma: Heads-up: customer calls this week surfaced two asks we didn't fully plan for: (1) migration credits / billing grace during model cutover, (2) an in-console signal for compat shims and their expected quality delta. Want to decide if these are MVP or stretch. Thoughts?

Priya: From CS: FinCorp will churn without a billing grace. They want 14 days of traffic-based credits when we flip pin -> new model. Can we offer a temporary routing mirror + credit?

Ravi: Billing side is doable but needs a usage reconciliation job and a flag in the routing ledger. Implementation cost estimate: ~3 dev wks + small infra job. Credits compute = sum(old_price - new_price) for mirrored requests.

Sofia: Evaluations: we need a signal that says "compat_shim: expected quality -0.03" or similar. We can provide a small A/B sampling harness that runs on 200 queries to surface a point estimate and confidence interval. That would be fast and informative.

Nate: Ops note: routing mirror for migration testing adds double reads to the serving path; we should run mirror sampling at 1-5% traffic to avoid overload. Canary window + progressive ramp recommended. Also add a kill-switch in case latency spikes.

Emma: For UX, Priya suggests a card during onboarding: "Enable migration credits (14d) and auto-mirror 1% traffic to new model for compatibility checks". Default off. That would require both billing and routing toggles.

Ravi: Proposed config prototype (draft):
```
model_migration: {
  enable_mirror: true,
  mirror_percent: 1,
  credit_window_days: 14,
  credit_mode: "traffic_delta"
}
```
We can wire this to a reconciliation job that emits a credit token attached to the tenant invoice.

Sofia: We should also compute a simple "quality delta" badge on the model page: green/orange/red based on p95 quality regressions and sample size. Rules: red if quality drop > 2% with p < 0.05. Need to standardize metric.

Priya: Playbook request: sample customer email + rollback steps if they reject migration. Ideally CS can trigger rollback from console within the 14d.

Nate: Add observability: time-series for mirror-error-rate, mirror-latency, and sample-quality-delta. OpsBot: Created alert template MIGRATE_HIGH_LATENCY -> paging if mirror latency p99 > 2x baseline.

Ravi: Rough prioritization: billing reconciliation + mirror infra = 1.5 sprints; sampling harness + quality badge = 1 sprint; console flows + playbook = 0.5 sprint. If we compress, MVP could be shipping the badge + manual credit process (paper credits) first week, and automate credits in sprint 2.

Emma: Decision: for MVP we ship badge + 1% manual mirror option + customer playbook. Automated billing credits and console opt-in will be next sprint. Owners: Ravi billing/mirror infra, Sofia eval badge, Nate routing/ops, Priya comms/playbook.

Priya: I'll draft the playbook + customer email, will include rollback copy and SLA language.

Sofia: I'll add sampling script and a small notebook to compute quality delta; will commit to repo under kits/migration-harness.

Ravi: I'll open infra tickets and a small billing RFC. Will post cost estimate by Wed.

Emma: Thanks. Sync Friday 9am to sign-off on wording and ship criteria. /cc @OpsBot :rocket:
